$comment: The coverage floor, for every package in this workspace. It moved here from packages/nx-polyglot-graph/vitest.config.mjs the moment a second package earned a test target, which is what that file said would happen: four numbers copied into two configs are not a hardcode, they are an unsynced config, and the copy that loses is always the one nobody edited. Each vitest.config.mjs reads this file rather than importing it — a relative import from inside a project to a root-level file is a boundary violation this repository's own checker reports, and JSON has no import anyway. 80 is a floor and not a target: it exists so a change that deletes coverage fails instead of passing quietly. Both suites sit well above it. Raising it is a real decision — a floor set at what today's suite happens to reach turns every future refactor into a coverage negotiation.
